posts.subject: Changelog 01.08.2017
posts.bodyHtml:
All Servers:

  • Player limiter plugin has been installed to block players trying to join on an already full server

TTT:

  • The following maps have been added:

    • ttt_border_b20_sgedit-1
    • ttt_caboose

Knife:

  • The following maps have been added:

    • 35hp_2000_[dm]
    • 35hp_alex_the_allegator
    • 35hp_lego_2
    • 35hp_oldschool_2017_[dm]
    • ka_greybone
    • ka_kei
    • ka_outside_aztec


As always, we appreciate any feedback on occuring bugs!
Special thanks to @Mr. Baguette for suggesting above additions.
Nice. Freut mich.
Do not hesitate to report any bug.

good job.
I'm very happy about the new plugin that block players when the server is full, i have suggested it myself on a thread that i made, and thanks to @Mr. Baguette for creating it, it will be good if you also apply the other suggestion that I made, kicking players that are on Spectator mode for too long, because they also use a slot, and when we block the player from joining with console, slots will be very important.
so as i said before, we should add a plugin for fixing that.



Thanks again



best regards
Mason
